snippet.title: Official HYPERFUNK Teaser
snippet.description:
You can support us by wishlisting HYPERFUNK on Steam. More info and screenshots: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3183480/HYPERFUNK

Team Reptile's new game is called HYPERFUNK. An extreme trick and graffiti game in which the higher your combo score, the faster you can boost. Follow the story of a crew called MACH10 and compete with the other crews in dynamic style wars or hang out online with friends.

Music: Dj Zapy & Dj Uragun - Sch Amo (Hyper Version)
https://open.spotify.com/track/6y9jRrs7S1Ix0pp3HlqdXO

Coming to PC & consoles

Names and details are subject to change.
